title: County pension costs and the state retirement shortfall
summary: The chair proposed in October 2026 moving other items, including a pension fund deficit inquiry, to the next meeting. At a March 2024 meeting, the retirement system leader said Maui County paid $5.8 million for pension spiking, or sharp pay jumps before retirement. The health fund leader said the County is projected to fully fund retiree health costs in 2031.
